about: Host Digital Inc. develops, owns, and operates data centers in the United States. It provides fully commissioned facilities on powered-shell and turnkey bases for artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads. Additionally, the company operates full-service natural and organic grocery stores under the Ada's Natural Market, Paradise Health & Nutrition, Mother Earth's Storehouse, Green's Natural Foods, Ellwood Thompson's, and GreenAcres Market brands. The company retails natural and organic groceries, including meat raised without hormones, antibiotics, or animal by-product feed, and USDA certified organic produce. It also retails vitamin supplements and personal care products online, and operates dietary supplement retail stores. Host Digital Inc. was formerly known as Healthy Choice Wellness Corp. and changed its name to Host Digital Inc. in September 2026. Host Digital Inc. was incorporated in 2022 and is based in Hollywood, Florida.
